description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the JsonKey interface, providing methods to create and manipulate JSON keys, including equality, hash coding, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonKey
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the JsonKey interface, encapsulating a String as the key value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableJsonKey from a CharSequence, returning an existing JsonKey if applicable, or throwing exceptions on invalid input.

methods.name: asPointer
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer representation of this key.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string from start to end.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on keyValue.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on keyValue.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key.
